The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the pebble-grain texture of the leather. (3) The hand lifts the wallet out of the box and turns it over to show a zippered pocket on the back. The gold hardware glints under the studio-style lights. Yellow and white text bubbles with pin icons appear at the bottom of the screen. (4) The main gold zipper is pulled open, and the person uses their fingers to spread the wallet wide, showing the dark burgundy interior lining. White paper inserts are visible in the multiple vertical card slots on both sides. (5) The final shot returns to a static close-up of the front of the black quilted leather wallet. The hands adjust their grip to center the golden logo perfectly in the frame. The white marble background remains clean and uncluttered, providing a high-contrast setting that emphasizes the luxury item's details before the clip ends.
